args.title: Fix missing or incorrect column headers causing 'Malformed row' error on CSV upload
args.body:
File: src/i18n/en.json

The recurring 'Malformed row: the number of columns does not match the header' error on row 1 suggests a problem with CSV column headers processing. This patch proposes to review and fix how the headers are interpreted or validated to support the new accounting export tool format, ensuring compatibility and correct parsing of the first row columns.
